ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: with_max_readers and const_with_max_readers now panic when max_reads==0; write/write_owned/try_write/try_write_owned add debug_assert_ne!(self.mr, 0). Previously max_readers=0 made write() acquire 0 permits, defeating mutual exclusion and enabling UAF/UB.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'Require that an RwLock has max_readers != 0'. Body shows a concrete UAF repro: with max_readers=0, two write() calls both succeed because write acquires self.mr (=0) permits, so mutual exclusion is broken. Reviewer ADD-SP independently confirmed UAF under Miri. This is a precondition / assumption_boundary fix on a public constructor.
